verdict.rationale: Skyfire is an identity and payments platform for AI agents. A dashboard or in-product AI assistant is a plausible feature for this kind of SaaS developer platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows infrastructure that external agents consume (an MCP server, token APIs, and the auto-created 'Buyer Agent', which is an identity/wallet entity rather than an assistant you delegate to). Nothing in the pack shows a built-in AI assistant inside the product that carries out tasks for the user.
